turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is this volume all right for you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, as long as you do not turn away.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I came along to help her today.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not felt right lately, my chest is bothering me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is a tight squeezing feeling in the middle.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it travel to your neck or shoulder?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it stays right where it is.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How long have you been having it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About three days ago, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, walking up the hill makes it come on.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What have you done to get relief?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not taken anything for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you short of breath when this happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I feel winded.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not fainted.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you break out in a sweat with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I get clammy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have diabetes, and I have high cholesterol. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has anyone in your family had heart trouble at a young age?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My father had a heart attack in his fifties.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever had a heart procedure, like a stent or bypass surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I had bypass surgery years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What medicines do you take every day?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I do not take any medicines.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, let me go over the plan. First, see the heart specialist within two weeks. Second, come back to this clinic in one week. Third, take one baby aspirin every morning.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I will go over it again with her at home.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any other questions?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I think I understand.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
